newsitem.title: INDIA: Three guerrilla leaders killed in Kashmir - police.
newsitem.headline: Three guerrilla leaders killed in Kashmir - police.

text.p: Three senior leaders of the Hizb-ul-Mujahideen guerrilla group were killed on Saturday morning in a shootout with paramilitary soldiers, police in India's Jammu and Kashmir state said.
The early-morning gunbattle erupted in the Manabal suburb of Kashmir's summer capital Srinagar, police said.
"This has crippled the backbone of the Hizbul. It is a major success," A.K. Suri, Additional Director-General of Police told Reuters.
He named the three guerrilla leaders as Firdous Kirmani, Manzoor Ahmed Malik, and Abdul Majid Wani.

More than a dozen militant groups are fighting for independence or merger with neighbouring Pakistan in Jammu and Kashmir, mainly Hindu India's only Moslem-majority state. Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed since the separatist rebellion broke out in 1990.
